   387→        they are buffered until there is room to run it.

   390→            if not self.running:
   391→                await asyncio.sleep(self.step_interval)
   392→                continue
   393→

   396→                task for task in self._ongoing_tasks.values() if task.done()

   405→                    (t, c)
   406→                    for t, c in self._outstanding_calls.items()
   407→                    if t not in self._ongoing_tasks
   408→                ]
   409→

   412→                    break
   413→                task = asyncio.create_task(self.process_call(current_call))

   407→    async def send_task_to_service(self, task_def: TaskDefinition) -> TaskDefinition:
   408→        if task_def.session_id is None:
   409→            raise ValueError(f"Task with id {task_def.task_id} has no session")
   410→
   411→        session = await self.get_session(task_def.session_id)
   412→
   413→        next_messages, session_state = await self._orchestrator.get_next_messages(
   414→            task_def, session.state
   415→        )
   416→
   417→        logger.debug(f"Sending task {task_def.task_id} to services: {next_messages}")
   418→
   419→        for message in next_messages:
   420→            await self.publish(message)
   421→
   422→        session.state.update(session_state)
   423→
   424→        await self._state_store.aput(
   425→            task_def.session_id,

   388→

   392→        they are buffered until there is room to run it.

   395→            if not self.running:
   396→                await asyncio.sleep(self.step_interval)
   397→                continue
   398→
   399→            # Check for completed tasks
   400→            completed_tasks = [
   401→                task for task in self._ongoing_tasks.values() if task.done()
   402→            ]
   403→            for task in completed_tasks:
   404→                task_id = next(k for k, v in self._ongoing_tasks.items() if v == task)
   405→                self._ongoing_tasks.pop(task_id, None)
   406→
   407→            # Start new tasks
   408→            async with self.lock:
   409→                new_calls = [
   410→                    (t, c)
   411→                    for t, c in self._outstanding_calls.items()
   412→                    if t not in self._ongoing_tasks
   413→                ]
   414→
   415→            for task_id, current_call in new_calls:
